lifecycle: created when a trusted project's machine is realized for a checkout; listed as orphaned when no trusted project holds ID or the checkout is gone

INSTANCE is the checkout it was realized for, so two worktrees never reset one VM; a definition may opt into sharing the main checkout's. Kept off the project directory so multi-GB disks never land on a synced folder or a network share. An instance records what tells a reused worktree path from the original (SKILL.md), and quickchr prune removes gone checkouts and releases their claims.
